task_objective: Make automatic Ludusavi save sync fail safe: cap every managed command and preview at three minutes, keep launch gates frozen until guarded work is cancelled and reaped, require backend-owned gates for every start-side mutation, and surface bounded lifecycle contention instead of silently skipping sync.
red_tests: Task 1 pinned the former 900-second real-operation, 300-second preview, 960-second watchdog, and 930000-ms status values as intentional failures before the three-minute policy was implemented.

Task 3 established the missing project-owned executor API, process-group timeout/reap behavior, token-scoped cancellation, PID-reuse protection, and adapter installation as RED coverage before the executor was added.

Task 5 established missing, stale, expired, thawed, and replacement-gate rejection; cancellation-before-thaw; shutdown ordering; and zero-mutation behavior without the exact gate before backend-gate implementation.
Task 7 established bounded coordinator waiting for lifecycle checks, fail-fast mutations, fresh-state decisions, and visible `operation_running` outcomes before contention behavior was implemented.

Task 9 added `test_process_check_treats_a_proc_lookup_race_as_stopped`. It failed before the helper change with an uncaught `ProcessLookupError` from `Path.read_text()` after the process probe succeeded.
Task 9 also added `test_wait_for_text_waits_for_populated_file`. It failed before the helper fix because the empty output file was returned as an empty string before its writer populated it.
mutation_checks: Restoring an old timeout value makes the exact-value timeout-policy test fail.
Bypassing managed process-group termination makes the descendant-process assertion fail.
Bypassing a backend launch-gate guard makes the in-flight lease-loss safety test fail.
Restoring non-blocking lifecycle checks or treating `operation_running` as silent makes the focused contention tests fail.
The Task 9 helper regression passes only when `_is_running()` treats both `FileNotFoundError` and `ProcessLookupError` from the disappearing `/proc/<pid>/stat` entry as a stopped process.
The empty PID-file regression passes only when `_wait_for_text()` waits for non-empty helper output instead of returning as soon as its file exists.
design_decisions: The project-owned executor preserves pyludusavi's public response/error contract while owning new-session process groups and token-scoped cancellation; vendored pyludusavi files remain unchanged.

The watchdog, not the frontend promise race, is the authority for start-side mutations. It atomically validates and pins the exact lease before Ludusavi starts, then cancellation and worker completion precede thaw.
Unconfirmed termination/reaping fails closed by retaining the gate. This is deliberately preferable to permitting the game to write while a restore or conflict backup might still change saves.

Lifecycle previews can wait for up to 30 seconds under the coordinator so they operate on fresh state. Mutations remain fail-fast so a decision cannot be applied after another operation changed the saves.
The status strip has an independent 210-second ceiling: late success is suppressed after the ceiling, while late failure remains visible and produces one failure toast.
